about: Subject of each national spirit picture (lane I5), keyed by picture key (idea id without zin_). Written from each spirit's name and description (localisation/english). One object or emblem per picture; no figures with faces, no crosses, no crossed objects, no real-world religious or national symbols, no modern objects.
